name: Eye of the Tornado refunds Static on spender and killing critical strikes (#13008)
contract: Eye of the Tornado 706297 tooltips: your damaging critical strikes now refund 5 Static. Its spell_proc row
fires Add 5 Static 804044 on a critical damaging hit; 804044 opens with a SPELL_EFFECT_DUMMY on
TARGET_UNIT_TARGET_ANY and only its Effect1 (SPELL_EFFECT_ASCENSION_MODIFY_AURA_STACKS, EffectMiscValue 5 on
Static 803102) targets the caster. The proc casts it at the struck enemy, so when the critical hit kills
that enemy the dead explicit target fails the cast and no Static is refunded; #13008 reports the missing
refund on killing blows and on Static spenders such as Aeroblast. Expected (ruled by the PR author: a
killing critical still refunds): an Aeroblast (801839, depletes 50 Static) that crits a living enemy leaves
80 - 50 + 5 = 35 Static, and one that crits and kills a 1 health enemy leaves 35 as well. Spell crit rating
forces every critical, an aggressive mob keeps the Stormbringer in combat so Static does not decay, and the
Stormbringer never auto attacks, so no melee critical can add Static, and Tempest Calling is not learned, so
